consequence.statement: Only a new, experimental status condition is written to AuthorizationPolicy. Nothing is rejected or ignored. Do not depend on the condition's format, because the evidence says it will change.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 now writes an experimental status condition on an AuthorizationPolicy when it is bound to a waypoint proxy; a policy with multiple targetRefs gets a single condition for now.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names AuthorizationPolicy but not the API group or the status field path where the condition is written, so a crd-field identity cannot be spelled from the text.; applicability: The evidence does not say which configuration produces the binding to a waypoint, beyond mentioning targetRefs, so no exposure predicate can be written from the text.
